dvars.name: bg_bouncesAllAngles
dvars.description: Enables bouncing from all surface angles

dvars.name: bg_climbAnything
dvars.description: Allows players to climb any surface

dvars.name: bg_disableBarrierClips
dvars.description: Disables barrier clip volumes on the map

dvars.name: bg_elevators
dvars.description: Controls elevator movement behavior for players

dvars.name: bg_refill_grenade_launcher_with_onemanarmy
dvars.description: Refills grenade launcher when using One Man Army

dvars.name: bg_replace_painkiller_with_adrenaline
dvars.description: Replaces Painkiller perk effect with adrenaline

dvars.name: bg_surfacePenetration
dvars.description: Enables bullet surface penetration through geometry

dvars.name: cg_drawSplatter
dvars.description: Enable/disable blood splatter overlay on screen

dvars.name: cg_fov
dvars.description: Field of view in degrees (default 65, max ~80 for MP)

dvars.name: cg_noclip_scaler
dvars.description: Sets speed multiplier for noclip mode

dvars.name: cg_ufo_scaler
dvars.description: Sets speed multiplier for UFO/fly mode

dvars.name: com_busyWait
dvars.description: Enables busy-wait loop for frame timing (affects CPU usage)

dvars.name: com_maxfps
dvars.description: Maximum framerate cap. 0 = unlimited. 85 is IW4 default.

dvars.name: fx_enable
dvars.description: Master switch for all particle effects

dvars.name: fx_marks
dvars.description: Enable/disable FX impact marks on surfaces

dvars.name: fx_marks_smodels
dvars.description: Enable/disable FX marks on static models

dvars.name: g_gravity
dvars.description: World gravity (800 = normal, lower = moon gravity)

dvars.name: iw4x_fail2ban_location
dvars.description: Path to the log file used by fail2ban integration

dvars.name: iw4x_onelog
dvars.description: Merges all log output into a single file

dvars.name: player_backSpeedScale
dvars.description: Movement speed scale when walking backwards

dvars.name: player_sprintTime
dvars.description: Sprint duration in seconds before exhaustion

dvars.name: r_aaSamples
dvars.description: Anti-aliasing sample count (1=off, 2=2x, 4=4x). Major FPS impact.

dvars.name: r_aspectRatio
dvars.description: Aspect ratio mode (auto, standard, wide 16:10, wide 16:9)

dvars.name: r_autopriority
dvars.description: Automatically lower process priority when game is minimized

dvars.name: r_depthPrepass
dvars.description: Depth pre-pass mode (None, Partial, Full). Can improve or hurt FPS depending on GPU.

dvars.name: r_detail
dvars.description: Enable/disable detail textures overlaid on surfaces

dvars.name: r_distortion
dvars.description: Enable/disable screen distortion effects (heat haze, explosions)

dvars.name: r_drawDecals
dvars.description: Enable/disable bullet hole and impact decals

dvars.name: r_drawModelBoundingBoxes
dvars.description: Draws bounding boxes around all models

dvars.name: r_drawSceneModelCollisions
dvars.description: Draws collision meshes for scene models

dvars.name: r_filmTweakEnable
dvars.description: Enable custom film color grading (tweakable color correction)

dvars.name: r_filmUseTweaks
dvars.description: Use film tweak values instead of map defaults

dvars.name: r_forceLod
dvars.description: Force all models to a specific LOD level (none, high, medium, low, lowest)

dvars.name: r_forceTechnique
dvars.description: Forces a specific render technique for all surfaces

dvars.name: r_fullbright
dvars.description: Disables all lighting calculations, everything fully lit

dvars.name: r_fullscreen
dvars.description: Run in fullscreen mode (better FPS than windowed)

dvars.name: r_glow_allowed
dvars.description: Allow glow effect to be used (master switch)

dvars.name: r_listSamplers
dvars.description: Logs all texture samplers to console

dvars.name: r_lodScaleRigid
dvars.description: LOD distance scale for rigid/static models (lower = lower quality sooner)

dvars.name: r_lodScaleSkinned
dvars.description: LOD distance scale for skinned/animated models

dvars.name: r_normal
dvars.description: Enable/disable normal mapping for surface detail

dvars.name: r_picmip
dvars.description: Texture mip level (0=full, higher=lower quality). Reduces VRAM and improves FPS.

dvars.name: r_picmip_bump
dvars.description: Mip level for bump/normal map textures

dvars.name: r_picmip_spec
dvars.description: Mip level for specular map textures

dvars.name: r_preloadShaders
dvars.description: Preload shader programs to reduce hitching during gameplay

dvars.name: r_resampleScene
dvars.description: Enable scene resampling for resolution scaling

dvars.name: r_scaleViewport
dvars.description: Viewport resolution scale (0-1, lower = blurrier but faster)

dvars.name: r_texFilterAnisoMax
dvars.description: Maximum anisotropic filtering level (1-16). Lower = better FPS.

dvars.name: r_texFilterMipBias
dvars.description: Mipmap bias offset (negative = sharper, positive = blurrier)

dvars.name: r_vsync
dvars.description: Vertical sync — caps FPS to monitor refresh rate. Disable for uncapped FPS.

dvars.name: ragdoll_enable
dvars.description: Enable/disable ragdoll physics for dead bodies

dvars.name: rate
dvars.description: Maximum network data rate from server (bytes/sec)

dvars.name: react_password
dvars.description: IW4x React auth service setting: password

dvars.name: react_username
dvars.description: Username for IW4x React authentication service

dvars.name: scr_player_healthregentime
dvars.description: Time in seconds before health regeneration starts

dvars.name: sm_fastSunShadow
dvars.description: Use fast sun shadow algorithm (lower quality, better performance)

dvars.name: snaps
dvars.description: Client snapshot rate (snapshots requested from server per second)

dvars.name: sv_cheats
dvars.description: Enable cheat-protected DVARs on the server

dvars.name: sv_randomMapRotation
dvars.description: Randomizes the server map rotation order

dvars.name: xblive_privatepartyclient
dvars.description: Controls Xbox Live session flag: privatepartyclient

dvars.name: xblive_privateserver
dvars.description: Controls Xbox Live session flag: privateserver

dvars.name: xblive_rankedmatch
dvars.description: Controls Xbox Live session flag: rankedmatch
